name: Almond Cookie "Witches Fingers" with Raspberry Jam

instructions.primary_message: Cut butter into small pieces. Set aside until softened, about 1 hour.
Line a large baking sheet pan with parchment paper; set aside.
Using a strainer, sift powdered sugar into the bowl of a standing mixer fitted with a paddle attachment.

Add softened butter, almond extract, vanilla extract, and salt to the bowl with the powdered sugar. Mix on medium-low speed until mixture is smooth and creamy, about 1 minute. Stop the mixer and scrape down the sides of the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp almond extract
½ tsp vanilla extract
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add flour and milk to the bowl. Mix on medium-low speed until a firm (but not stiff) dough forms, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ¼ cups all-purpose flour
2 tsp whole milk

instructions.primary_message: Using a scant tablespoon measure, take scoops of the dough and shape them into balls. Next, roll each ball into a 3-inch long by ½-inch wide log that resembles a finger. Arrange on the baking sheet, spacing them 1-inch apart (the cookie fingers will spread a little during baking).
Shape one end of each finger into a flat, pointed edge to resemble a fingertip. Using a knife, score creases at intervals on the fingers to create "knuckles."
Cover cookie fingers with plastic wrap. Place fingers in the fridge and chill for at least 8 hours or overnight.
When you are ready to bake the cookies, preheat the oven to 350°F.

Once the oven is heated, remove baking sheet from the fridge and discard plastic wrap. Place cookies in the oven and bake until golden and firm to the touch, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool completely on the baking sheet, about 30 minutes.
To assemble, place ⅛ tsp raspberry jam on the flat, pointed ends of the cookie fingers; gently press a sliced almond into the jam to create "nails."
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp raspberry jam, seedless
⅛ cup almonds, sliced

instructions.primary_message: Transfer cookies to a serving platter and enjoy!
